segments.name: s1_intro
segments.text: Assalam o Alaikum! Aaj hum seekhenge Python ki basics.

segments.name: s2_variables
segments.text: Sab se pehle variables. Name mein string hai Ahmed, age mein number 25. Height decimal 5.9, aur is_student boolean True.

segments.name: s3_datatypes
segments.text: Ab type function se data types check karte hain. Dekho: name string hai, age integer, height float.

segments.name: s4_operations
segments.text: Ab operations. Numbers pe arithmetic; age mein 5 joro, result 30. Strings ko plus se joro; Hello Ahmed.

segments.name: s5_fstrings
segments.text: F-strings se variables ko sentence mein dalo. Len string ki lambai batata hai.

segments.name: s6_outro
segments.text: Practice karte raho, agle video mein functions seekhenge. Allah Hafiz!
